{"parentUuid":"201efcfd-e9b1-424e-acfa-09337aa52373","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"48b12788-c981-47f3-b65f-5777062df810","agentId":"afdbbce8eca7def81","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_012QeJET3kpzxE8TnG4mbiyn","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"The host-backend contract (Phase 7, WS-D). A `HostBackend` captures screen/camera into the same\n2\t`Frame` the perception stack already consumes, and advertises what the host can do. The capability\n3\tdescriptor is what the mesh routes on (see `sigil.mesh`): which host has a camera, a GPU for a local\n4\tVLM, and is always-on — so vision/compute go to the best-capable ONLINE host while authority stays\n5\tin the one signed spine.\"\"\"\n6\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n7\t\n8\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n9\tfrom typing import Optional, Protocol, runtime_checkable\n10\t\n11\tfrom ..perception.capture import Frame\n12\t\n13\t\n14\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n15\tclass CapabilityDescriptor:\n16\t    host_id: str\n17\t    os: str\n18\t    has_screen: bool\n19\t    has_camera: bool\n20\t    has_gpu_vlm: bool          # a local moondream-class VLM is reachable (Ollama up)\n21\t    always_on: bool\n22\t    has_hid_inject: bool = False    # this host can inject cursor/keyboard events (WS-F gesture control)\n23\t    has_camera_stream: bool = False # this host can stream the camera (persistent, low-latency)\n24\t\n25\t    def to_dict(self) -> dict:\n26\t        return {\"host_id\": self.host_id, \"os\": self.os, \"has_screen\": self.has_screen,\n27\t                \"has_camera\": self.has_camera, \"has_gpu_vlm\": self.has_gpu_vlm, \"always_on\": self.always_on,\n28\t                \"has_hid_inject\": self.has_hid_inject, \"has_camera_stream\": self.has_camera_stream}\n29\t\n30\t\n31\t@runtime_checkable\n32\tclass HostBackend(Protocol):\n33\t    def capture_screen(self) -> Optional[Frame]: ...\n34\t    def capture_camera(self) -> Optional[Frame]: ...\n35\t    def capabilities(self) -> CapabilityDescriptor: ...\n36\t\n37\t\n38\t# --- shared, OS-agnostic probes ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n39\tdef host_id() -> str:\n40\t    \"\"\"A stable per-host id (persisted once under SIGIL_HOME). Identifies this host in the mesh.\"\"\"\n41\t    import uuid\n42\t\n43\t    from ..config import SIGIL_HOME\n44\t    f = SIGIL_HOME / \"host_id\"\n45\t    try:\n46\t        v = f.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").strip()\n47\t        if v:\n48\t            return v\n49\t    except OSError:\n50\t        pass\n51\t    SIGIL_HOME.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n52\t    hid = uuid.uuid4().hex[:16]\n53\t    try:\n54\t        f.write_text(hid, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n55\t    except OSError:\n56\t        pass\n57\t    return hid\n58\t\n59\t\n60\tdef probe_gpu_vlm() -> bool:\n61\t    \"\"\"True iff a local moondream-class VLM endpoint (Ollama) is reachable — cheap TCP probe.\"\"\"\n62\t    import os\n63\t    import socket\n64\t    from urllib.parse import urlparse\n65\t    u = urlparse(os.environ.get(\"OLLAMA_HOST\", \"http://127.0.0.1:11434\"))\n66\t    try:\n67\t        with socket.create_connection((u.hostname or \"127.0.0.1\", u.port or 11434), timeout=0.5):\n68\t            return True\n69\t    except OSError:\n70\t        return False\n71\t\n72\t\n73\tdef probe_always_on() -> bool:\n74\t    import os\n75\t    return os.environ.get(\"SIGIL_ALWAYS_ON\", \"\").lower() in (\"1\", \"true\", \"yes\")\n76\t"}]},"uuid":"6f9c9fc4-0865-4b0b-9400-14789ef51025","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:30:30.912Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"201efcfd-e9b1-424e-acfa-09337aa52373","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main/.claude/worktrees/agent-afdbbce8eca7def81","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

Additive; returns None when the native tool is absent.\"\"\"\n3\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n4\t\n5\timport shutil\n6\timport subprocess\n7\timport tempfile\n8\tfrom pathlib import Path\n9\tfrom typing import Optional\n10\t\n11\tfrom ..perception.capture import Frame, _ocr\n12\tfrom .base import CapabilityDescriptor, host_id, probe_always_on, probe_gpu_vlm\n13\t\n14\t\n15\tclass MacOSBackend:\n16\t    def capture_screen(self) -> Optional[Frame]:\n17\t        if not shutil.which(\"screencapture\"):\n18\t            return None\n19\t        out = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=\".png\", prefix=\"sigil-screen-\")\n20\t        try:\n21\t            subprocess.run([\"screencapture\", \"-x\", out], capture_output=True, timeout=20)\n22\t        except (subprocess.SubprocessError, OSError):\n23\t            return None\n24\t        if Path(out).exists() and Path(out).stat().st_size > 0:\n25\t            return Frame.from_image(\"screen\", out, text=_ocr(out))\n26\t        return None\n27\t\n28\t    def capture_camera(self) -> Optional[Frame]:\n29\t        return None                                   # honest gap (optional imagesnap add)\n30\t\n31\t    def capabilities(self) -> CapabilityDescriptor:\n32\t        return CapabilityDescriptor(\n33\t            host_id=host_id(), os=\"macos\", has_screen=bool(shutil.which(\"screencapture\")),\n34\t            has_camera=False, has_gpu_vlm=probe_gpu_vlm(), always_on=probe_always_on())\n35\t"}]},"uuid":"385da686-27ad-41e6-b1cc-7bb322b9bd21","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:30:31.929Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"27ca6d06-7868-43d6-ad34-c4ef213a3b07","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main/.claude/worktrees/agent-afdbbce8eca7def81","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"6f3c1a9a-89fe-4c69-8199-506b4ed5a59e","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"48b12788-c981-47f3-b65f-5777062df810","agentId":"afdbbce8eca7def81","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_018Z4n17w4EzVp33w7qW9R6n","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Windows backend (Phase 7, WS-D) — screen via the optional `mss` package; camera an honest gap.\n2\tAdditive; returns None when `mss` is unavailable.\"\"\"\n3\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n4\t\n5\timport tempfile\n6\tfrom pathlib import Path\n7\tfrom typing import Optional\n8\t\n9\tfrom ..perception.capture import Frame, _ocr\n10\tfrom .base import CapabilityDescriptor, host_id, probe_always_on, probe_gpu_vlm\n11\t\n12\t\n13\tdef _has_mss() -> bool:\n14\t    try:\n15\t        import mss  # noqa: F401\n16\t        return True\n17\t    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n18\t        return False\n19\t\n20\t\n21\tclass WindowsBackend:\n22\t    def capture_screen(self) -> Optional[Frame]:\n23\t        try:\n24\t            import mss\n25\t            out = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=\".png\", prefix=\"sigil-screen-\")\n26\t            with mss.mss() as sct:\n27\t                sct.shot(output=out)\n28\t            if Path(out).exists() and Path(out).stat().st_size > 0:\n29\t                return Frame.from_image(\"screen\", out, text=_ocr(out))\n30\t        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — no mss / grab failure → honest None\n31\t            return None\n32\t        return None\n33\t\n34\t    def capture_camera(self) -> Optional[Frame]:\n35\t        return None\n36\t\n37\t    def capabilities(self) -> CapabilityDescriptor:\n38\t        return CapabilityDescriptor(\n39\t            host_id=host_id(), os=\"windows\", has_screen=_has_mss(), has_camera=False,\n40\t            has_gpu_vlm=probe_gpu_vlm(), always_on=probe_always_on())\n41\t"}]},"uuid":"839ca221-7633-4874-9890-7207f0f15bf6","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:30:32.521Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"6f3c1a9a-89fe-4c69-8199-506b4ed5a59e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main/.claude/worktrees/agent-afdbbce8eca7def81","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}
{"parentUuid":"b2701d44-1798-4db6-a386-762a34429f0a","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"48b12788-c981-47f3-b65f-5777062df810","agentId":"afdbbce8eca7def81","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_015dyXaGCeTA1JbH95hNmxhe","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Linux backend (Phase 7, WS-D) — wraps the existing perception capture verbatim (behaviour-\n2\tpreserving; the whole stack above is unchanged).\"\"\"\n3\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n4\t\n5\timport shutil\n6\tfrom pathlib import Path\n7\tfrom typing import Optional\n8\t\n9\tfrom ..perception.capture import Frame, grab_camera, grab_screen\n10\tfrom .base import CapabilityDescriptor, host_id, probe_always_on, probe_gpu_vlm\n11\t\n12\t_SCREEN_TOOLS = (\"scrot\", \"gnome-screenshot\", \"spectacle\", \"import\")\n13\t\n14\t\n15\tclass LinuxBackend:\n16\t    def capture_screen(self) -> Optional[Frame]:\n17\t        return grab_screen()\n18\t\n19\t    def capture_camera(self) -> Optional[Frame]:\n20\t        return grab_camera()\n21\t\n22\t    def capabilities(self) -> CapabilityDescriptor:\n23\t        from .input import has_hid_inject\n24\t        cam = Path(\"/dev/video0\").exists()\n25\t        return CapabilityDescriptor(\n26\t            host_id=host_id(), os=\"linux\",\n27\t            has_screen=any(shutil.which(t) for t in _SCREEN_TOOLS),\n28\t            has_camera=cam, has_gpu_vlm=probe_gpu_vlm(), always_on=probe_always_on(),\n29\t            has_hid_inject=has_hid_inject(), has_camera_stream=cam and bool(shutil.which(\"ffmpeg\")))\n30\t"}]},"uuid":"a9309d61-7ed0-4a5b-9abe-5f1128ca43a5","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:30:32.523Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"b2701d44-1798-4db6-a386-762a34429f0a","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main/.claude/worktrees/agent-afdbbce8eca7def81","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"b7efc16a-1124-480b-87d0-d3b5bd8030ec","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"48b12788-c981-47f3-b65f-5777062df810","agentId":"afdbbce8eca7def81","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01NxaeRoE4QXgYBgV8H7rTZe","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Capture backends (SIGIL §8). A `Frame` is the immutable record of one capture: the image bytes'\n2\tsha256 (integrity), the OCR/accessibility TEXT (the GROUND TRUTH a query is answered from), and a\n3\tpath to the image. Real backends shell out to whatever is installed (screenshot tool + tesseract,\n4\tv4l2/ffmpeg); every backend returns `None` on any failure — a missing camera is no capture, never a\n5\tfabricated one (same posture as SCHOLAR.read_source). `StaticFrame` is the deterministic test double.\n6\t\n7\tHONEST GAPS: headless hosts often lack a screenshot tool / tesseract / a camera, so the real\n8\tbackends degrade to `None` or an image-only Frame (text=\"\"). The richest real screen source is the\n9\tOS accessibility tree (C4); it is not available on a headless box and is left as a documented seam.\"\"\"\n10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n11\t\n12\timport shutil\n13\timport subprocess\n14\timport tempfile\n15\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n16\tfrom pathlib import Path\n17\tfrom typing import Optional\n18\t\n19\tfrom ..reuse import sha256_hex\n20\t\n21\t_SCREENSHOT_TOOLS = (\n22\t    (\"scrot\", [\"scrot\", \"-o\"]),\n23\t    (\"gnome-screenshot\", [\"gnome-screenshot\", \"-f\"]),\n24\t    (\"spectacle\", [\"spectacle\", \"-b\", \"-n\", \"-o\"]),\n25\t    (\"import\", [\"import\", \"-window\", \"root\"]),   # ImageMagick\n26\t)\n27\t\n28\t\n29\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n30\tclass Frame:\n31\t    kind: str                       # \"screen\" | \"camera\"\n32\t    sha256: str                     # integrity of the captured image bytes\n33\t    text: str                       # OCR / accessibility text — the GROUND TRUTH; \"\" if none\n34\t    image_path: Optional[str] = None\n35\t    width: int = 0\n36\t    height: int = 0\n37\t\n38\t    @classmethod\n39\t    def from_image(cls, kind: str, image_path: str, *, text: str = \"\") -> \"Frame\":\n40\t        data = Path(image_path).read_bytes()\n41\t        return cls(kind=kind, sha256=sha256_hex(data), text=text, image_path=image_path)\n42\t\n43\t\n44\tdef _ocr(image_path: str) -> str:\n45\t    \"\"\"Extract text via tesseract if present; '' otherwise (no OCR is not a failure of capture).\"\"\"\n46\t    if not shutil.which(\"tesseract\"):\n47\t        return \"\"\n48\t    try:\n49\t        proc = subprocess.run([\"tesseract\", image_path, \"stdout\"],\n50\t                              capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)\n51\t        return (proc.stdout or \"\").strip()\n52\t    except (subprocess.SubprocessError, OSError):\n53\t        return \"\"\n54\t\n55\t\n56\tdef grab_screen() -> Optional[Frame]:\n57\t    \"\"\"Screenshot the current display + OCR it. Returns None if no screenshot tool is available\n58\t    or the grab fails. The accessibility-tree path (richer, C4) is a documented seam, not wired\n59\t    on headless hosts.\"\"\"\n60\t    out = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=\".png\", prefix=\"sigil-screen-\")\n61\t    for name, argv in _SCREENSHOT_TOOLS:\n62\t        if not shutil.which(name):\n63\t            continue\n64\t        try:\n65\t            proc = subprocess.run([*argv, out], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)\n66\t        except (subprocess.SubprocessError, OSError):\n67\t            continue\n68\t        if proc.returncode == 0 and Path(out).exists() and Path(out).stat().st_size > 0:\n69\t            return Frame.from_image(\"screen\", out, text=_ocr(out))\n70\t    return None\n71\t\n72\t\n73\tdef grab_camera(device: str = \"/dev/video0\") -> Optional[Frame]:\n74\t    \"\"\"Grab a single frame from a v4l2 camera via ffmpeg. Returns None if ffmpeg or the device is\n75\t    absent, or the grab fails. Camera frames rarely carry text, so OCR is best-effort.\"\"\"\n76\t    if not shutil.which(\"ffmpeg\") or not Path(device).exists():\n77\t        return None\n78\t    out = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=\".png\", prefix=\"sigil-cam-\")\n79\t    try:\n80\t        proc = subprocess.run(\n81\t            [\"ffmpeg\", \"-y\", \"-f\", \"v4l2\", \"-i\", device, \"-frames:v\", \"1\", out],\n82\t            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)\n83\t    except (subprocess.SubprocessError, OSError):\n84\t        return None\n85\t    if proc.returncode == 0 and Path(out).exists() and Path(out).stat().st_size > 0:\n86\t        return Frame.from_image(\"camera\", out, text=_ocr(out))\n87\t    return None\n88\t\n89\t\n90\tdef StaticFrame(*, kind: str = \"screen\", text: str = \"\", tag: str = \"\") -> Frame:\n91\t    \"\"\"Deterministic test/double frame — no filesystem, sha256 derived from (tag or text) so\n92\t    identical content hashes identically (drives ambient change-detection).\"\"\"\n93\t    return Frame(kind=kind, sha256=sha256_hex((tag or text).encode()), text=text, image_path=None)\n94\t"}]},"uuid":"97539621-0236-420c-bc09-98418f4e2778","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:30:38.620Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"b7efc16a-1124-480b-87d0-d3b5bd8030ec","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main/.claude/worktrees/agent-afdbbce8eca7def81","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"1833d96b-5408-4eaf-b492-a91b963d547c","isSidechain":true,"agentId":"afdbbce8eca7def81","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdAPt9HGjYC2LbQwf3HTw","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01KCvRbGTwgfiat1MrHCiCaK","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/kali/sigil/sigil/platform/android.py","content":"\"\"\"Android/Termux backend (Phase 9, W2-J) — a phone that runs the SIGIL Python core under Termux.\nThis is the SECONDARY phone path (the primary is the PWA client in another workstream); it exists so\na Termux host is described HONESTLY instead of silently masquerading as Linux — on Termux\n`sys.platform == \"linux\"`, so without this the `host()` selector would return a LinuxBackend that\nlies about `os` and probes `/dev/video0` that a phone does not have.\n\nCamera via `termux-camera-photo` from the `termux-api` package; screen via Android's `screencap`\nwhen present (usually unavailable without root — honest `None` then). A phone does NOT inject HID\ninto the PC, so `has_hid_inject` is honestly `False`. Additive; every capture returns `None` on any\nfailure (subprocess with a timeout, no shell). Offense-free.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nimport subprocess\nimport tempfile\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Optional\n\nfrom ..perception.capture import Frame, _ocr\nfrom .base import CapabilityDescriptor, host_id\n\n\ndef _has_camera() -> bool:\n    return shutil.which(\"termux-camera-photo\") is not None\n\n\ndef _has_screencap() -> bool:\n    return shutil.which(\"screencap\") is not None\n\n\nclass AndroidBackend:\n    def capture_screen(self) -> Optional[Frame]:\n        if not _has_screencap():\n            return None                                # honest gap — no screencap (often root-only)\n        out = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=\".png\", prefix=\"sigil-screen-\")\n        try:\n            subprocess.run([\"screencap\", \"-p\", out], capture_output=True, timeout=20)\n        except (subprocess.SubprocessError, OSError):\n            return None\n        if Path(out).exists() and Path(out).stat().st_size > 0:\n            return Frame.from_image(\"screen\", out, text=_ocr(out))\n        return None\n\n    def capture_camera(self) -> Optional[Frame]:\n        if not _has_camera():\n            return None                                # honest gap — termux-api not installed\n        out = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=\".jpg\", prefix=\"sigil-cam-\")\n        try:\n            subprocess.run([\"termux-camera-photo\", \"-c\", \"0\", out],\n                           capture_output=True, timeout=30)\n        except (subprocess.SubprocessError, OSError):\n            return None\n        if Path(out).exists() and Path(out).stat().st_size > 0:\n            return Frame.from_image(\"camera\", out, text=_ocr(out))\n        return None\n\n    def capabilities(self) -> CapabilityDescriptor:\n        return CapabilityDescriptor(\n            host_id=host_id(), os=\"android\",\n            has_screen=_has_screencap(), has_camera=_has_camera(),\n            has_gpu_vlm=False, always_on=False,\n            has_hid_inject=False, has_camera_stream=False)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":4778,"cache_read_input_tokens":43320,"output_tokens":1129,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":4778},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1129,"cache_read_input_tokens":43320,"cache_creation_input_tokens":4778,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":4778,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CdAPt84MaQZA5cdqfY8P2","attributionAgent":"general-purpose","type":"assistant","uuid":"7361d254-9331-499b-a54d-343944a4f53d","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:32:08.093Z","effort":"xhigh","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main/.claude/worktrees/agent-afdbbce8eca7def81","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}
